title: Topic 18: Clothes & Colours - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Name clothes and colours; describe what people are wearing

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Clothes shop flyer format
MODA MIA - NEW CLOTHES THIS WEEK!
White shirts ......... twenty dollars
Red dresses .......... forty dollars
Black shoes .......... thirty-five dollars
Winter jackets ....... fifty dollars
* THIS WEEK ONLY: two white shirts for thirty dollars!
Open Monday to Saturday, nine to seven.
We are next to the bank - come and see the new
colours!

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Bia:  Rafa, help me! The party is at eight, and I am
      looking at my clothes NOW. Blue dress or white
      shirt?
Rafa: Your blue dress is super!
Bia:  Hmm... no. Blue is not my colour.
Rafa: OK: the white shirt, and your new black shoes!
Bia:  Yes!! Perfect. And you? What are you wearing?
Rafa: My green jacket, of course. I love it!

readingQuestions.question: How much are the black shoes?
It is very cold in your city. Which thing in this shop is for you?
What is this chat about?
options: Bia chooses clothes for a party tonight
Bia buys a dress in a shop
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: Bia chooses clothes for a party tonight

readingQuestions.question: What does Bia wear in the end?
options: The white shirt and black shoes
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: The white shirt and black shoes

readingQuestions.question: Bia asks: What ___ you ___? (about clothes, right now/tonight)
